task: Mask secrets and cap/drop unbounded free-text fields in claude-code-otlp hook event payloads before spooling/forwarding to CodeMie analytics, skip tool_response for sensitive-file Reads, and add per-field unit tests.

key_reasoning.reason: OtlpAgentAdapter.limitPayload/buildEvent (shared base class also used by copilot-chat-otlp and copilot-cli-otlp), a new shared text-masking util in src/utils, and the claude-code-otlp plugin onPostToolUse/onPreToolUse handlers for sensitive-file Reads. Spool and forwarder stay untouched (byte-for-byte contract). Touching a shared base class and a shared util gives L.

Closest existing pattern is utils/security.ts (sanitizeLogArgs/sanitizeValue), but its value patterns are whole-string anchored and cannot mask secrets embedded in prose, .env dumps or command output, and maskString leaks 8 chars. The security-sensitive aspect is therefore not covered, which is a divergence and bumps risk. No runtime embedded-secret scanner exists, so a new regex pattern set is needed. Risks: mask-before-truncate ordering; prompt_body computed separately from the unmasked original; raw duplicates the whole event; masker must not corrupt the agentId in tool_response that the backend uses for fork attribution; masking structured tool_input before stringify; already-spooled events stay unmasked. ACs enumerate many secret variants (API key, token, password, private key, connection string) and there is no existing parameterized-pattern test template for forwarded fields, which is a second bump.
